recommendations.title: Doctor-led / Mehwargy Reels
recommendations.observation: Long doctor-led Reels are the clearest structural underperformer.
recommendations.data: Doctors Content: n=5, avg Creative Score 69, avg Performance Score 29. Thyroid Reel: 61/12 at 295.83s; Child Nutrition: 54/14 at 298.41s; Breast Cancer: 63/29 at 404.34s.
recommendations.interpretation: The medical topics are useful, but the feed format asks for too much viewing time before delivering individual answers.
recommendations.recommendedAction: Use long episodes as source material. Publish 30-60s question-led clips on Reels and keep full episodes for YouTube.

recommendations.title: Events / On-ground Content
recommendations.observation: Short, real-world event Reels are the most consistent performance pattern.
recommendations.data: Events: n=10, avg Performance Score 62. El Alamein 75, Marathon 73, Family Day 70, Pavilion Park 70; most are about 22-39s.
recommendations.interpretation: Movement, people, location and visible real-world participation create stronger feed-native proof than institutional messaging.
recommendations.recommendedAction: Prioritize 20-40s event Reels with people/action in the first 2s and the hospital role visible immediately.

recommendations.title: Clinical Service Hooks
recommendations.observation: Problem/question-led clinical framing is stronger than generic capability statements.
recommendations.data: Examples: Prostate symptoms Creative/Performance 86/77; Root-canal retreatment 84/69; Dental emergencies 84/51. Generic expert statement 'الخبرة تصنع الفارق' scored 75/21.
recommendations.interpretation: Specific patient questions create a clearer reason to stop and continue than broad expertise claims.
recommendations.recommendedAction: Open clinical Reels with one patient question/problem and give the direct answer before credentials.

recommendations.title: Branding Reels
recommendations.observation: Branding-only Reels have lower performance than event/patient-value content.
recommendations.data: Branding: n=3, avg Creative Score 60, avg Performance Score 42. Generic review-thank-you Reel: 49/19; Mawlid greeting: 60/46.
recommendations.interpretation: Strong identity does not replace audience value. Pure institutional messages give viewers less reason to interact.
recommendations.recommendedAction: Turn branding into human proof: employee/patient/community story, concrete achievement, or real moment.

recommendations.title: Scientific Event Promotion
recommendations.observation: Speaker/problem-led scientific promotion outperforms poster-heavy packaging.
recommendations.data: Solving Antimicrobial Riddles speaker invite: Creative/Performance 80/80. Poster-style event promo: 74/46.
recommendations.interpretation: Scientific credibility works best when delivered through a person and a reason to attend, not as a dense information card.
recommendations.recommendedAction: Use expert-led 20-30s invitation clips; reveal date/time/registration after the value proposition.

recommendations.title: Creative vs Performance Gap
recommendations.observation: Half of reviewed Reels have strong creative but weak relative performance.
recommendations.data: 17 of 34 Reels fall into Strong Creative / Weak Performance. Only 6 of 34 are Strong Creative / Strong Performance.
recommendations.interpretation: Creative execution is often acceptable; topic fit, length, distribution or the first-message choice are frequently the limiting factors.
recommendations.recommendedAction: For Creative Score >=70 and Performance Score <70, diagnose topic/length/distribution before redesigning the visual identity.

actionPlan.action: Cut every new Mehwargy/doctor episode into 3-5 standalone 30-60s Reels, each answering one question.
actionPlan.expectedImpact: Higher retention and more reusable medical content
actionPlan.baseline: Jul Mehwargy examples: 1.78%-3.20% Avg Watched; Performance 12-14

actionPlan.problem: Event Reels are the most consistent pattern
actionPlan.action: Use a 20-40s event template: action in first 2s -> hospital role -> benefit/service -> branded close.
actionPlan.expectedImpact: More reliable reach and engagement from on-ground events

actionPlan.action: For clinical/service Reels, replace general statements with one patient problem/question in the first frame/line.
actionPlan.expectedImpact: Stronger stopping power and clearer relevance
actionPlan.baseline: Several service Reels are around 19%-31% 3s Hold

actionPlan.action: Convert generic greetings/review-thank-you posts into human proof or community stories.

actionPlan.problem: Poster-heavy conference promo underperforms speaker-led promo
actionPlan.action: Create expert-led scientific event teasers before publishing the full information card.
actionPlan.owner: Marketing Coordinator + Content Creator + Video Editor
actionPlan.expectedImpact: Higher registrations and stronger scientific-event engagement
actionPlan.target: Performance Score >=65; track registrations per Reel

actionPlan.problem: 17/34 reviewed Reels show strong creative but weak performance
actionPlan.action: Create a weekly exception review for Creative >=70 and Performance <70; test one change at a time: topic, hook, length or distribution.
actionPlan.expectedImpact: Faster diagnosis instead of unnecessary redesigns
actionPlan.targetKpi: Share of Strong Creative / Weak Performance
actionPlan.target: Reduce to <35% in the next reviewed month
